findings.title: Division by zero or NaN in percentage announcement
findings.problem: When complete_state is zero or negative, or when current_state/complete_state results in NaN (e.g., 0/0), Math.round() returns NaN or Infinity. The announcement then includes literal 'NaN%' or 'Infinity%' to the screen reader.
findings.impact: Screen reader announces invalid accessibility message. User receives malformed status notification instead of a meaningful percentage.
findings.recommendation: Guard complete_state before division: const percentage = (info.isInProgress && !info.isProviderInProgress && item.complete_state > 0) ? ` ${Math.clamp(Math.round((item.current_state / item.complete_state) * 100), 0, 100)}%` : ''

findings.title: Percentage not clamped to 100% when current exceeds complete
findings.problem: If current_state > complete_state, the percentage calculation produces >100%. The announcement includes this invalid percentage value.
findings.impact: Announced progress percentage exceeds 100%, semantically incorrect and confusing to users relying on screen reader.

findings.title: No announcement when rows removed from table
findings.problem: The hook tracks previous items in previousRef.current Map. When items disappear (removed from the array), no announcement triggers. The old entry stays in previousRef but is not cleaned or announced as gone.
findings.impact: Screen reader users do not receive auditory confirmation that a row was removed from the table. Silent deletion violates a11y contract.
findings.recommendation: After forEach, compare previousRef keys to next keys; for any id in previous but not next, announce removal: `announce(`${item.repo_name} removed`)`

findings.title: Null or undefined repo_name renders malformed announcement
findings.problem: Template at line 36 uses `${item.repo_name}:` directly. If repo_name is null or undefined, the announcement reads 'null: Completed' or 'undefined: Completed'.
findings.impact: Source identification is lost; screen reader user cannot identify which row the status change applies to.
findings.recommendation: Guard repo_name: const safeName = item.repo_name || `Datasource ${item.id}`; const text = `${safeName}: ${info.title}${percentage}`

findings.title: Whitespace-only announcements bypass useAnnouncementQueue guard
findings.problem: The hook passes text directly to announce(). The useAnnouncementQueue checks `!message` (line 68), which passes for whitespace-only strings like ' ' or '\t'. These get queued and rendered to the aria-live region, sending no audible notification.
findings.impact: Screen reader emits no sound for whitespace announcements. User receives visual confirmation but no audio, breaking accessibility contract.
findings.recommendation: Guard before announce(): if (!text.trim()) return; or trim the text in template: const text = `${safeName}: ${info.title}${percentage}`.trim()

findings.title: Burst updates exceed queue capacity; middle messages lost
findings.problem: The hook calls announce() in a forEach loop, potentially multiple times per render if many rows change status simultaneously. useAnnouncementQueue caps its queue to 5 items (line 70 in useAnnouncementQueue.ts). If more than 5 items change, the oldest queued items are discarded and never announced.
findings.impact: When the table updates with >5 simultaneous status changes, only the last 5 are announced to the screen reader. Middle status changes are silently lost.
findings.recommendation: Collect all text strings in one render, then call announce() once with aggregated changes or increase maxQueueSize in useAnnouncementQueue call

findings.title: Missing zero-guard on complete_state before division
findings.problem: Line 34 divides item.current_state by item.complete_state without checking if complete_state is zero or negative. Zero division produces Infinity; negative division produces negative percentages.
findings.impact: Invalid math result announced to screen reader; accessibility message is nonsensical.
